newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's PM says Deng's death a "great loss".
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's PM says Deng's death a "great loss".

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad called the death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping a "great loss" to China and the world, the national Bernama news agency reported on Friday.

In his first official statement on the death of the Chinese leader, Mahathir said Deng was the main architect of China's drive for reforms towards modernisation and the adoption of an "open door" policy.
Mahathir said Deng, who died late on Wednesday at the age of 92, was also responsible for enhancing China's role in maintaining world peace and stability, Bernama reported.
Calling Deng's death "not only a great loss to China but also to the world", Mahathir said Deng was greatly admired for his efforts.
"China's burgeoning economy today is testimony of the resounding success of his pragmatic policies," Mahathir said in his condolence message to Chinese premier Li Peng.
The message was released by the foreign ministry on Friday.
